name: Mechanical Engineering
notes: Students cannot declare a minor until accepted into a major, and cannot elect satisfactory/fail for minor courses.
No more than two courses from the minor may be used toward a separate major or minor.
Course selections are evaluated and managed by Professor Lambropoulos before the declaration form is submitted.
The department also offers Aerospace Engineering and Materials Science minors, not yet encoded.
The page presents five four-course themes; students pick one.

requirementGroups.label: Four-course theme
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Fluid Dynamics and Thermal Sciences: ME 223, ME 225, ME 241, ME 251. Materials and Solid Mechanics: ME 226, ME 240, ME 280, ME 281. Fluid Mechanics and Solid Mechanics: ME 225, ME 226, ME 241, ME 240. Mechanical Design: ME 204, ME 205, ME 222, ME 226. Structural Analysis: ME 204, ME 226, ME 254, ME 440.
